frontMatter.title: Eid Mubarak: Wishing You a Joyful Eid Al-Fitr
frontMatter.summary: Eid Mubarak to all celebrating Eid Al-Fitr—wishing you joy, peace, and memorable moments with family and friends.

prev.title: Thursday Club Night
prev.summary: Thursday Club Night — Grade 2 and Grade 4 Ladies teams matches, then enjoy 2 courts available from 9:30pm for extra games.

next.title: Meath Badminton: Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals – 22nd March
next.summary: This Sunday (22nd March), Meath competes in the Leinster CAC Intercounty Finals in Baldoyle and Tolka Rovers, with club members representing the county across every grade. Semi-finals start at 10am, finals at 2pm—best of luck to all teams. An Mhí Abú!
